description: This file defines a utility function 'aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost' that aggregates agent costs and usage data from MongoDB collections 'session_tracking' and 'llm_costs'. It processes various data structures, normalizes currency strings, applies filters, and merges results to produce a summarized report of agent usage and costs.

methods.name: toNumberSafe
methods.description: A helper function that safely converts currency-like strings (e.g., '$0.108255') or other inputs into numeric values.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that queries MongoDB collections, processes data, and returns a summarized report of agent costs and usage, supporting filters and pagination.
